README: DataTidy

DataTidy cleans spreadsheet files before analysis.

Installation: run the command pip install datatidy. You need Python 3.10 or newer.

Usage: open a terminal in your data folder and run datatidy clean input.csv. The cleaned file will be saved as input_clean.csv.

If you find a bug, please open an issue on the project page and include the error message.
